original_title: Cambodia says Thailand still bombing despite Trump ceasefire claim

ai_analysis.detailed_analysis: Active military conflict involving aerial bombardment despite reported ceasefire. Thai jets conducting cross-border strikes indicates escalation potential. Displacement of 500,000 civilians creates humanitarian crisis that could spill into neighboring regions. Potential for conflict to disrupt regional supply chains and transport routes.
ai_analysis.immediate_forecast_24h: High probability of continued aerial operations and ground clashes. Possible expansion of conflict zone. Risk of accidental strikes on civilian infrastructure including roads and supply routes near border areas.
ai_analysis.strategic_outlook: Long-standing border dispute unlikely to resolve quickly. Potential for prolonged conflict affecting regional stability. May impact ASEAN relations and international trade routes if conflict escalates further. Monitoring required for potential spillover into maritime and air transport sectors.
ai_analysis.operational_impact: Avoid all non-essential travel within 50km of Cambodia-Thailand border. Heightened alert for cargo transiting through border checkpoints. Potential for flight diversions or airspace restrictions. Increased risk to personnel in conflict-adjacent regions. Monitor for possible supply chain disruptions.
